messages.subject: Global Mining & Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Jones,

Metallum Partners' dedicated executive-search work across mining, metals, infrastructure and the energy transition makes this a highly focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, critical minerals, energy transition and responsible development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
